newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria's ATX loses ground after 8-day rally.
newsitem.headline: Austria's ATX loses ground after 8-day rally.

text.p: The Austrian ATX index of 21 blue chips snapped an eight-day winning streak on Thursday to end one percent lower as it buckled under profit-taking.

The ATX lost 14.10 points, or 1.01 percent, to 1,385.3 points after trading between 1,377.26 and 1,399.59. Weak international leads and dwindling demand on the futures side had also weighed on the cash market, traders said.
Traders said the market needed to go through a corrective period to consolidate its recent rally into record territory.
"I think the consolidation will continue a bit," said one trader, but thereafter the market would resume its upward trek.
"The Vienna market's been rediscovered," he said.
Of the ATX's constituents, 13 fell while eight advanced.
The day's worst performing ATX issue was beverages group BBAG, down 4.9 percent at 790 schillings, while AMS led gainers, adding on 1.42 percent to 1,075.
The broad-based Vienna bourse index lost 3.71 points, or 0.74 percent, to 499.51.
The July ATX future fell 14.1 points to 1,394 on turnover of 910 contracts.
